name: Palotina (Brazil)
description: White field with an off-centred cross of dark blue and red, each arm divided lengthwise, and a dark blue star in the upper hoist.
history: Palotina is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag was designed by Arthur Luponi: white for peace, friendship and loyalty, with a Latin cross for the faith.
